overall: The new pricing page reads clearly on desktop, but the mobile layout breaks the design system: the primary CTA loses its brand color and the card grid overflows the viewport. Two nits on spacing.

findings.title: Primary CTA uses an off-brand color on mobile
findings.description: On the mobile viewport the primary 'Start free trial' button renders with the default blue instead of the brand accent token, breaking visual hierarchy and brand consistency.
findings.suggestion: Apply the `--color-accent` token (or the `btn-primary` class) so the CTA matches the brand accent used elsewhere.

findings.title: Pricing card grid overflows the mobile viewport
findings.description: The three-column pricing grid does not collapse below 640px, causing horizontal scrolling on the mobile viewport.
findings.suggestion: Switch the grid to a single column under the `sm` breakpoint.

findings.title: Inconsistent vertical rhythm between feature rows
findings.description: Feature rows alternate between 24px and 32px vertical spacing on desktop.
findings.suggestion: Use a single spacing token for consistent vertical rhythm.

notReviewed: route /checkout (no preview deployment matched the expected revision)
